structure.name: LegalConsiderations
structure.description: Final document of legal considerations for the company.

value.summary: MediFlow AI collects user data under a single consent checkbox, which does not explicitly separate distinct processing purposes.
value.rationale: The company uses a single checkbox for Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, covering multiple purposes without explicit consent for each distinct purpose.

value.summary: MediFlow AI collects health data without a separate, affirmative opt-in consent recorded and time-stamped.
value.rationale: Health data is collected under a general consent mechanism, lacking a separate, affirmative opt-in consent.

value.summary: MediFlow AI encrypts data in transit using TLS 1.3 but does not encrypt data at rest.
value.rationale: Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3, but encryption at rest is not implemented.

value.summary: MediFlow AI stores and processes EEA resident data in the US without an approved transfer mechanism.
value.rationale: EEA resident data is stored in AWS us-east-1 (Northern Virginia) without segregation or an approved transfer mechanism.

value.summary: MediFlow AI provides a clear explanation of logic and a route to human review for urgent cases flagged by its AI system.
value.rationale: The company offers a clear explanation of AI logic and routes urgent cases for human review.

value.summary: MediFlow AI's incident-response runbook specifies breach reporting within five business days, exceeding the 72-hour requirement.
value.rationale: The company's breach reporting timeline exceeds the 72-hour requirement.
